Home.title: Konnected
Home.lede: Short project assignments for students and startups. Konnected approves every project and matches the students.
Home.placeholder: This page is a placeholder. The dashboards come in later steps.
Home.teamEndedBody: This address is no longer on the Konnected team list. Ask the team if you need access again.

ChooseRole.title: How will you use Konnected?
ChooseRole.lede: Signed in as {email}. Pick the option that fits. Konnected checks every student profile and every company before they take part.
ChooseRole.student1: Build a profile and upload your CV
ChooseRole.student2: Apply to projects Konnected has approved
ChooseRole.student3: Deliver through Konnected, and on paid projects get paid through Konnected
ChooseRole.company2: Submit a project with a clear deliverable, paid or unpaid
ChooseRole.company3: Konnected finds the student and releases the result to you

Entry.title: Short, real projects for university students
Entry.lede: Startups send in a project, paid or unpaid. Konnected decides if it goes ahead, picks a student and handles any payment.
Entry.factReview: Konnected reviews every company and every student profile.
Entry.factPrivacy: Companies never browse students. They see only what a selected student agreed to share.
Entry.factCoordinate: Konnected coordinates the work and the payment.
Entry.tabsLabel: Sign in or create an account
Entry.teamGoogle: Konnected team members sign in with Google.
Entry.ruleBreach: Checked against known data breaches when you save
Entry.confirmFirst: We email you a link to confirm your address before your first sign-in.
Entry.linkSentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
Entry.spamHint: Nothing in your inbox? Look in your spam folder.
Entry.verifySentBody: We sent a message to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm your address. After that you can sign in with your password.
Entry.verifySentNote: You cannot sign in with a password before you confirm your email.
Entry.sessionEndedBody: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

MagicLink.title: Sign in to Konnected
MagicLink.lede: Press the button to finish signing in. The link works once.
MagicLink.expiredLede: Sign-in links work once, and only for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.

Verify.title: Confirm your email
Verify.lede: Press the button to confirm this address for your Konnected account.
Verify.doneLede: You can sign in with your password now.
Verify.invalidLede: It may have been used already. Try to sign in. If your email still needs confirming, we send you a new link.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Konnected
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Confirm your address to finish creating your Konnected account. After that you can sign in with your password.
verify.ignore: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email. The account cannot be used without this step.

magicLink.subject: Your Konnected sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Konnected
magicLink.body: Use the button to sign in to Konnected. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without the link.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Konnected account
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to create a new Konnected account with this address. You already have one, so nothing was changed.
accountExists.howTo: Sign in with Google, with an email sign-in link, or with your password. If you forgot your password, choose “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.
accountExists.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.

team.heading: Konnected team accounts sign in with Google
team.link: Someone asked for a sign-in link for this address.
team.signup: Someone tried to create an account with this address.
team.reset: Someone asked to reset the password for this Konnected account.
team.google: Konnected team accounts sign in with Google only, so no link was sent and nothing has changed.
team.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Konnected password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for this Konnected account. Use the button within an hour. The link works once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password has not changed.

methodAdded.subject: A new way to sign in was added
methodAdded.heading: A new way to sign in to Konnected
methodAdded.google: Google is now linked to your Konnected account. From now on you can sign in with Google.
methodAdded.password: A password was set for your Konnected account. From now on you can sign in with your email and this password.
methodAdded.body: Konnected links a way to sign in only when it uses the same verified email address as your account.
methodAdded.notYou: If this was not you, write to the Konnected team right away so we can secure your account.

accountPaused.subject: Your Konnected account is paused
accountPaused.heading: Your account is paused
accountPaused.body: The Konnected team has paused your account. You cannot sign in until the team makes it active again. Nothing has been deleted.
accountPaused.contact: If you think this is a mistake, write to the Konnected team.
accountPaused.ignore: You get this email so you know why you cannot sign in.

accountReactivated.subject: Your Konnected account is active again
accountReactivated.heading: Your account is active again
accountReactivated.body: The Konnected team has made your account active again. You can sign in as before.
accountReactivated.ignore: If you did not expect this, write to the Konnected team.

roleChanged.subject: Your Konnected account type was changed
roleChanged.heading: Your account type was changed
roleChanged.student: The Konnected team changed your account to a student account.
roleChanged.company: The Konnected team changed your account to a company account.
roleChanged.body: The answers you gave for the other account type were removed. Next time you sign in, Konnected asks the questions for your new account type.
roleChanged.ignore: If you did not ask for this, write to the Konnected team.

projectSubmitted.subject: Konnected received your project
projectSubmitted.heading: Your project is with Konnected
projectSubmitted.body: Thank you. Konnected received “{title}” and will review it.
projectSubmitted.review: We review projects within a few working days. Konnected may approve it, ask you for changes, or tell you why it cannot go ahead. Students see nothing until Konnected publishes it.
projectSubmitted.next: You get an email when the review is done. You cannot edit the project while it is in review.
projectSubmitted.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

companyApproved.subject: Your company is approved on Konnected
companyApproved.heading: Your company is approved
companyApproved.body: Konnected has approved {name}. You can now send in your first project.
companyApproved.next: Konnected reviews every project before students see it.
companyApproved.ignore: If you did not register this company, write to the Konnected team.

companyRejected.subject: Konnected could not approve {name}
companyRejected.heading: Konnected could not approve your company
companyRejected.body: Konnected looked at {name} and could not approve it. The reason:
companyRejected.resend: If something can be corrected, correct your details in your company profile and send them again. You can do this once.
companyRejected.final: If you think this is a mistake, write to the Konnected team.
companyRejected.ignore: If you did not register this company, write to the Konnected team.

companyInfo.subject: Konnected needs more information about {name}
companyInfo.heading: Konnected needs more information
companyInfo.body: Konnected is reviewing {name} and needs a little more from you:
companyInfo.resend: Correct your details in your company profile and save them. Your company stays in review until then.
companyInfo.ignore: If you did not register this company, write to the Konnected team.

projectChanges.subject: Konnected asks for changes to your project
projectChanges.heading: Changes asked
projectChanges.body: Konnected reviewed “{title}” and asks you to change a few things:
projectChanges.next: Edit the project and send it again. It comes back to Konnected for review.
projectChanges.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

projectRejected.subject: Konnected could not approve your project
projectRejected.heading: Your project was not approved
projectRejected.body: Konnected reviewed “{title}” and cannot take it on. The reason:
projectRejected.next: You are welcome to send a new project that fits better.
projectRejected.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

projectApproved.subject: Konnected approved your project
projectApproved.heading: Your project is approved
projectApproved.price: The fixed price is {price} excluding VAT ({total} including 25% VAT). Payment terms are 14 days.
projectApproved.next: Konnected publishes it for students next. You get an email when it is published.
projectApproved.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

projectPublished.subject: Your project is published on Konnected
projectPublished.heading: Your project is published
projectPublished.next: Konnected picks one student by hand after applications close and tells you who it is.
projectPublished.ignore: If you did not send this project, write to the Konnected team.

profileReviewed.subject: Konnected reviewed your profile
profileReviewed.heading: Your profile is reviewed
profileReviewed.next: Konnected can now select you for a project. Keep your profile up to date.
profileReviewed.ignore: If you do not have a Konnected profile, write to the Konnected team.

profileChanges.subject: Konnected asks you to update your profile
profileChanges.heading: Please update your profile
profileChanges.body: Konnected looked at your profile and asks you to change a few things:
profileChanges.next: Update your profile and save it. It comes back to Konnected for review. You can still browse and apply in the meantime.
profileChanges.ignore: If you do not have a Konnected profile, write to the Konnected team.

DesignGuide.title: Design base
DesignGuide.lede: The Estuary tokens and components. This page exists only in development.

TeamHome.title: Today

TeamHome.panelBody: Payload's own admin panel is still at /admin, as a fallback for the team.

ProjectStatus.offTrack: Rejected projects do not go further. You can submit a new project.

send.title: Send for review
send.body: Konnected reviews every project before students see it.

review.title: Konnected reviews
review.body: We review projects within a few working days. Konnected may approve the project, ask for changes or reject it.

resubmit.title: Send it again
resubmit.body: Edit the project and send it for review again.

work.title: Work starts
work.body: Konnected agrees the scope and the due date with the student.

deliver.title: Final delivery
deliver.body: Konnected checks the work before it is released to you.

release.title: Konnected checks and releases
release.body: You see the result only after release.

CompanyProjects.title: My projects
CompanyProjects.lede: You follow the status here. Konnected handles the students.
CompanyProjects.emptyBody: Describe the work you need. Konnected reviews it before any student sees it.
CompanyProjects.asksFallback: Check the project and send it for review again.

CompanyProject.sentBody: We review projects within a few working days. We sent you a confirmation by email, and you get another when the review is done.

draft.title: Only you can see this draft
draft.body: Konnected sees a project only after you send it for review.
draft.pending: Konnected sees a project only after you send it for review. You can send it once Konnected approves your company.

submitted.title: Konnected is reviewing this project
submitted.body: We review projects within a few working days. You get an email when it is done. You cannot edit the project while it is in review.

changes_requested.title: Konnected asks for changes
changes_requested.body: See the note from Konnected, edit the project and send it again.

rejected.title: Konnected did not approve this project
rejected.body: See the note from Konnected. You can submit a new project.

approved.title: Approved by Konnected
approved.body: Konnected prepares the project for students. You get an email when it is published.

published.title: Students can apply
published.body: Konnected assesses the applications and picks one student. You see the student after Konnected selects one.

matched.title: Konnected selected a student
matched.body: Konnected agrees the scope and the due date with the student, and keeps you updated.

in_progress.title: The student is working
in_progress.body: Konnected checks the work before it is released to you.

delivered.title: Delivered
delivered.body: Konnected checks the work before it is released to you.

CompanyProject.latestEmpty: Nothing yet. When Konnected has something to tell you about this project, you find it here.
CompanyProject.nothing: Nothing right now. Konnected has the next step.
CompanyProject.pendingHint: You can send it for review once Konnected approves your company.
CompanyProject.priceNote: Set by Konnected at review. Konnected sends the invoice; payment terms are {days} days.

TeamApprovals.title: Approvals
TeamApprovals.lede: Nothing reaches students until Konnected approves the company and the project. Every student profile is reviewed before matching.
TeamApprovals.waited: {count, plural, =0 {waiting since today} one {waiting # day} other {waiting # days}}

due.late: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
due.left: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

TeamApprovals.emptyMine: Nothing here is yours right now.

empty.students: No student profiles wait for review.

emptyBody.companies: No more companies wait for the team. New ones land here when they register.
emptyBody.projects: No more projects wait for the team. New ones land here when a company sends one.
emptyBody.students: No more student profiles wait for the team. New ones land here when a student finishes the onboarding.

TeamApprovals.checkedHere: Every decision is checked again on the server, written to the activity log and sent to the company or student by email.

activity.infoAnswered: The company saved its corrected details
activity.price: Price set to {price} kr excl. VAT

errors.forbidden: Your session has ended or this is not a team account. Sign in again.
errors.not_allowed: This decision no longer applies. Someone may have decided already. Reload the page.
errors.note_required: Write a note first. The company or student gets it by email.
errors.note_too_long: The note is too long. Keep it under {max} characters.
errors.price_required: Set the fixed price for a paid project.
errors.price_invalid: Write the price in whole kroner, for example 6500.
errors.student_pay_invalid: Write the student's pay in whole kroner, at most the price. Or leave it empty.
errors.company_not_approved: Konnected has not approved this project's company. Approve the company first.
errors.duplicate_org: Another approved company already has this organisation number. One company account per organisation number.
errors.generic: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Try again.

company.sameNumberTitle: Another company has this organisation number
company.sameNumberBody: Also registered: {names}. One company account per organisation number.
company.waitingBody: It stays pending and comes back to the queue when the company saves its details.
company.resentTitle: Sent again after a rejection, on {date}

decided.approved: Approved. The company can send projects for review.

company.check1: Organisation number found in the Brønnøysund register
company.check3: Contact person works at the company
company.approvedToast: {name} is approved and gets an email.
company.infoLabel: What should the company add or correct?
company.infoHint: The company gets this by email and sees it on its profile. It stays pending.
company.infoToast: Sent to {name}. It comes back here when they answer.

orgNumber.label: Organisation number
orgNumber.text: We could not find the organisation number in the Brønnøysund register. Please check it.

website.label: Website
website.text: Please add a website or a page that shows the company.

contact.label: Contact person
contact.text: Please confirm that the contact person works at the company.

company.rejectHint: The company gets this reason by email and may correct its details and send them once more. Konnected keeps it in the activity log.
company.rejectedToast: {name} is rejected and gets the reason by email.

project.waitingBody: The project comes back to the queue when the company sends it again.
project.unpaidBanner: Unpaid project. Decide if the work is fair to do without pay. If not, ask the company to make it paid or smaller.
project.companyNotApproved: The company is {status}. Approve the company first.
project.check3: A short assignment, not a job
project.check4: Paid or unpaid suits the work
project.priceLabel: Fixed price for the company (NOK, excl. VAT)
project.priceHint: Whole kroner. Konnected sets it now; the company sees it on the project and in the agreement. Payment terms 14 days.
project.unpaidNote: An unpaid project has no price and no payment rows.
project.studentPayLabel: What the student is paid (NOK, optional)
project.studentPayHint: Whole kroner, before tax, at most the price. Students see it on the project. The company never sees it. Leave it empty to show only "Paid".
project.approvedToast: {title} is approved. Publish it when it is ready for students.
project.changesHint: Tap a reason to add it, then edit the text. The company gets this by email.
project.changesToast: Sent to the company. {title} comes back here when they send it again.

deliverable.label: Deliverable unclear
deliverable.text: Describe exactly what you want back, and in which format.

workload.label: Too much work
workload.text: The workload looks too large for the timeframe.

language.label: Language
language.text: Say which language the work should be in.

job.label: Reads like a job
job.text: This reads like a job, not a short assignment.

paid.label: Should be paid
paid.text: This is too much work to do without pay. Please make the project paid, or make it smaller.

project.rejectHint: The company gets this reason by email.
project.rejectedToast: {title} is rejected. The company gets the reason by email.
project.publishBody: Students see the project and can apply once it is published. The company gets an email.

publish.confirmBody: Students can apply from now on. Konnected picks one student by hand after applications close.
publish.toast: {title} is published. Students can apply from now on.

profile.waitingBody: The profile comes back to the queue when the student saves it.
profile.changesTitle: What changed since the review on {date}
profile.noCvBody: Ask the student to upload one before you mark the profile as reviewed.
profile.sharedTitle: Shared with a company only after selection
profile.noAutoCheck: There is no automatic student check. Konnected reviews each profile by hand before matching.
profile.reviewedToast: {name}'s profile is reviewed. Konnected can now select them for a project.
profile.askHint: The student gets this by email and sees it on their profile.
profile.askToast: Sent to {name}. The profile comes back here when it is updated.

cv.label: Upload a CV
cv.text: Please upload your CV as a PDF.

year.label: Year of study
year.text: Please add your year of study.

interests.label: Interests
interests.text: Please choose at least one interest.

pitch.label: Pitch
pitch.text: Please write a few sentences about what you are good at.

StudentProjects.title: Projects
StudentProjects.lede: Every project here is approved by Konnected. Apply to the ones that fit.
StudentProjects.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, company or skill
StudentProjects.count: {count, plural, =0 {No open projects} one {# open project} other {# open projects}}
StudentProjects.emptyBody: Konnected approves every project before it shows here. Check back soon, and keep your profile up to date so Konnected can pick you.
StudentProjects.noMatchBody: Clear the search or change the filters.
StudentProjects.pastEndBody: The list is shorter now. Go back to the first page.

detail.paidNote: Before tax. Konnected pays you in the monthly pay run after the company has paid.
detail.paidNoAmount: Konnected tells you the amount before the work starts.
detail.unpaidNote: The company chose an unpaid project, and Konnected approved it.
detail.limit: You can work on up to 2 projects at a time.
detail.applyComing: Coming soon: applying opens in the next update.
detail.closedBody: Konnected is deciding, or has picked a student already.
detail.filesNote: Konnected shares the brief's attachments with the student it selects.
detail.notOpenBody: The link may be old, or the project may no longer be open. Your profile and the other projects are still here.
